impact_narrative: Orders p95 latency has doubled to 900ms, degrading roughly 450 order requests per minute.
cause_summary: The httpx 0.27->0.28 bump (commit abc1a46fb0) deployed 35 minutes before the regression; connection pool reuse behavior changed in the new httpcore, slowing orders->inventory calls.

runbook_citation.heading_path: Dependency Upgrade Runbook > Latency regression after a dependency bump
runbook_citation.why: Covers pinning back a regressed dependency and verifying pool reuse.

next_steps: Pin httpx back to 0.27 and redeploy orders.
Compare p95 before/after to confirm recovery.
File an upstream issue with the pool-reuse repro before re-attempting the upgrade.
